rows.reason: Application root; no resource create/edit pair.
Loads boards and launches the board-create dialog; not a separate resource pair.
Board create exposes title only, so it does not meet the two-text-field criterion.
Loads board/tasks, opens task by ID for editing, and implements status drag/drop; task text editing is delegated to TaskDialog.
TaskDialog maps description/title and color to Task, branches on task.id for create/update, and sets status TODO.

native_edit_entry: Double-click sticky-note element with persisted task ID; handler reads task by ID before opening dialog.
native_save_behavior: Handler subscribes to API write then immediately closes dialog and reloads page; ordinary controls must establish whether the request completes. No forced waits or application patch may replace native behavior.
